claim_boundary: The timings are exact fixed-shape fe2o3 Rust artifacts on one MI350X. Public libraries are architectural references unless every semantic, shape, precision, layout, fusion, oracle, and timer axis matches. No external state-of-the-art claim is made for an excluded comparison.

protocol.timer: ROCr HSA dispatch timestamps at 1 GHz
protocol.correctness: Every timed artifact passed the independent CPU oracle, immutable-input checks, output canaries, preflight dispatch, and validation after every timing block.

theoretical_bound.derivation: For each current batched launch: max(compulsory unique bytes / 8 TB/s, counted FP32 operations / 144.2 TFLOP/s, admitted low-precision operations / the named peak). This optimistic whole-device throughput floor excludes dispatch, dependencies, cache-line amplification, scalar/transcendental work, and occupancy limits.
